title: Execution Validation Record
description: The AGF serialization of an Execution-Time Authorization Validation check (Spec 30 §4): evidence that a PEP checked whether a previously issued Decision's Authorities are still valid immediately before dispatch, and what it found. Not a kernel object (Spec 00 §1's six objects are closed) — a Core-format artifact that correlates to the kernel Decision object (decision_ref) and, when applicable, existing kernel Invalidation records (invalidation_refs).

id.description: Unique identifier of this validation record.

decision_ref.description: id of the Decision (Spec 00 §3.4) this check was performed for.

authority_refs_checked.description: The specific Authority ids checked (Spec 30 §3) — normally all of decision_ref's authority_refs.

checked_at.description: Unix timestamp when the check was performed.

result.description: Whether every checked Authority was still valid at checked_at.

reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons for an invalid result. Empty when result is valid; one or more of the enum values MAY apply when invalid.

invalidation_refs.description: ids of the pre-existing Invalidation record(s) (Spec 00 §3.6) that caused an invalid result when authority_revoked applies. This check discovers pre-existing Invalidation records; it does not create new ones.

checked_by.description: Actor id of the PEP that performed the check.
